hero.title: Your City Services,
hero.description: Techno Amar brings all municipal services to your fingertips — submit complaints, request permits, assess property damage, and track everything from a single platform.

features.title: Everything You Need
features.subtitle: A complete digital platform designed to make municipal services faster, simpler, and more transparent for every citizen.

complaints.title: Submit Complaints
complaints.desc: Report issues in your neighborhood directly to the municipality and track their resolution in real time.

services.title: Municipal Services
services.desc: Apply for building permits, trade licenses, and more — all without leaving your home.

damage.title: Damage Assessment
damage.desc: Document and report property damage with photos and get an official evaluation from the municipality.

track.title: Track Your Requests
track.desc: Stay updated on the status of every service request and complaint through your personal dashboard.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of citizens already using Techno Amar to connect with their municipality.
